name: 웨이블릿 패킷 분해 분석
description: Applies full wavelet packet decomposition for fine-grained sub-band energy analysis (Coifman & Wickerhauser, 1992).
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies Wavelet Packet Decomposition (WPD) following Coifman & Wickerhauser (1992) for comprehensive frequency-domain forensic analysis:

1. **Full웨이블릿PacketTree**: Unlike standard DWT (which only decomposes the approximation subband), WPD recursively decomposes both approximation and detail subbands, creating a full binary tree of 2ⁿ subbands at depth n. This provides uniform frequency resolution across the entire spectrum.

2. **BestBasisSelection**: The optimal basis is selected via entropy-based cost function (Shannon entropy, log-energy, or threshold counting) minimization over the packet tree. The best basis structure itself is forensically informative — natural images optimize differently than AI 생성 ones.

3. **SubbandEnergy분포**: Energy distribution across all wavelet packet subbands is computed. Natural images follow predictable energy decay patterns related to the 1/f spectral falloff. AI artifacts produce 비정상적인 energy in specific subbands — GAN grid artifacts appear as energy peaks at characteristic spatial frequencies.

4. **Inter-Subband상관분석**: Cross-correlations between sibling and parent-child subbands capture statistical dependencies inherent in natural images. AI 생성 images often exhibit altered inter-subband correlation structures — either excessive independence (failing to replicate natural dependencies) or artificial correlations from generator architectures.

5. **계수분포Profiling**: Wavelet packet coefficient distributions at each node are modeled. Natural image coefficients follow generalized Gaussian distributions with scale-dependent parameters. Deviations from these models — particularly in high-frequency subbands where AI 생성기 struggle to reproduce correct statistics — are quantified for forensic scoring.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Coifman, R.R. & Wickerhauser, M.V. (1992). Entropy-Based Algorithms for Best Basis Selection. IEEE TIT.
Chang, S.G. et al. (2000). Adaptive Wavelet Thresholding for Image Denoising. IEEE TIP.
